string.name: perm_location_reason
string.value: CityTour uses your precise location to start a story when you reach a monument and to guide you to the next stop.

string.name: perm_background_reason
string.value: Keeps the tour guide running and talking while your phone is locked in your pocket.

string.name: perm_vibrate_reason
string.value: A short vibration tells you that you have arrived at a stop.
